page.title: Environment
page.description: Configuration and credentials the app reads at run time.

editor.title: Environment variables
editor.description: Plain configuration your app reads at run time. Use secrets for anything sensitive.

rows.keyRequired: Enter a name for this variable.
rows.valueRequired: Enter a value, or remove the row.
rows.duplicateKey: This name is already used by another row.

empty.title: No environment variables
empty.description: Add a variable or import a .env file.

dialog.description: Saving changes only this variable; other variables stay as they are.

confirm.title: Delete {{name}}?
confirm.description: Apps that read this variable see it missing after the next request.

keyInvalid: Use letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter or underscore.

parse.badLine: Line {{line}}: use KEY=VALUE with a valid name.

toast.conflict: Someone else changed these variables. The latest values are loaded; apply your change again.

denied.title: Requires the developer role
denied.description: Environment values can hold API keys, so only project developers and admins can read them. Ask a project admin for access.

previewEnv.title: Preview environment
previewEnv.description: Variables given to preview apps. Nothing is copied from production, and forks get them only if the approver says so.
previewEnv.rowKeyRequired: Enter a name for this variable.
previewEnv.rowValueRequired: Enter a value, or remove the row.
previewEnv.rowDuplicateKey: This name is already used by another row.
previewEnv.permission: Only developers and admins of this project can change this.
